title: Software Engineer - Frontend Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer - Frontend.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: JavaScript/TypeScript semantics, DOM manipulation, component lifecycle, CSS layout (Flexbox/Grid), and basic client-side state.
2. Mid-level: Component hierarchy design, state management (server vs client state), performance (virtualization, bundle size, re-renders), accessibility (a11y/ARIA), and responsive UI engineering.
3. Senior: Micro-frontends/monorepo architecture, SSR/SSG/hydration strategies, Web Vitals optimization (LCP, INP, CLS), client caching, security (XSS, CSRF, CSP), and design system scaling.
4. Staff-plus: Cross-platform web architecture, frontend infrastructure tooling (bundlers, build pipelines), multi-app synchronization, and design system governance.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Target the candidate's actual projects, UI libraries, or framework architectures listed in their brief.
- NEW-GRAD GUIDANCE: Focus on UI fundamentals, clean TypeScript/JavaScript, and browser APIs.

sections.heading: Interview Type Adaptation
lines: - domain-role: Deep dive into state management, rendering lifecycle, performance profiling, and browser internals.
- system-design: Focus on frontend architecture, offline support, real-time client sync, asset delivery networks, and resilient client caching.
